title: Rabbah bar Maryon

paragraphs: In Eruvin 19a: “Rabbah bar Maryon recited a baraita in [the school of] Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai” (a baraita arranged in his study house — Rashi). In Sukkah 32b the statement reads: “Rabbah bar Mari recited a teaching in the name of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman supplies ברבי; the William Davidson digital Eruvin 19a paragraph has בדבי רבי יוחנן בן זכאי, indicating the study house. The Vilna Rashi digital comment says ברייתא שנסדרה בבית מדרשו, “a baraita arranged in his study house,” not that Rabbah bar Maryon authored it. Sukkah 32b instead has Rabbah bar Mari reporting Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai; the forms and roles remain distinct.

Eruvin 19a has Rabbah bar Maryon reciting in the study house of Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakkai; Sukkah 32b instead has Rabbah bar Mari reporting Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai. Both passages also preserve an alternative transmission through Rabbi Maryon and Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. The retained earlier note reports Rashi's study-house gloss; that comment could not be freshly collated here. No authorship of the baraita or identity between the name forms is inferred.
